title: Positional expansion of a bit string
statement: For every natural number $L$ and every bit string $f : \mathrm{Fin}(L) \to \{0,1\}$, the value of the list of its bits, with the first entry least significant, is $\sum_{j=0}^{L-1} f(j)2^j$.
